summary: Suk Fun Ng is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned a PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2014) under Jing Yin, Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, and K. L. Dhammajoti. She served as Professor at Hong Kong Baptist University.

Sukhen Ghosh is an Indologist who completed a master's at Visva-Bharati University (2019-2021) and a Ph.D. at Mahatma Gandhi Central University in 2022, where he also served as a Senior Research Fellow in 2022.

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880-1978) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala and under Balakrishna Mishra. He held posts at Gujarat Vidyapith (1922), Banaras Hindu University (1934-1944), and Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (1944).

Sukra Sagar Shrestha (1956-2018) worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He served as an epigraphist at the Archaeological Survey of India (attested 1986) and the Department of Archaeology (attested 1987).

Sukumar Sen (1900-1992) was a linguist and Indologist. Educated at Burdwan Raj College, Sanskrit College, and University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and I. J. S. Taraporewala, he became Calcutta's lecturer (1930) and Khaira Professor (1954).

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921-2014) was an Indology scholar. She studied English at the University of Calcutta (~1941-1957) and earned a doctorate at Jadavpur University (~1964-1967). She taught at Lady Brabourne College (1945) and Jadavpur University (1957-1986).
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who studied under doctoral supervisor Pratap Bandyopadhyay (attested 2026). She held the H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar educated at Assumption College and the University of Wales, Lampeter (~1954-1957). He held visiting roles at Lampeter, UC Berkeley, Harvard, Toronto, and Cornell, and founded INEB in 1989.

Suman Chakraborty works in computational fields and Indology. Educated at Presidency University (B.Sc. 2008-2011) and University of Calcutta (M.Sc. 2011-2013), he held posts at IUCAA, the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science (2019), and IIT Kharagpur (attested 2023).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is an Indologist and historian. She studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania (~1987-1993), later holding faculty positions at Pennsylvania (~1995-1997) and the University of Michigan (~1997-2007).

Sumi Lee is a scholar in Buddhist studies. She completed an MA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign under Alexander L. Mayer and earned a PhD at the University of California, Los Angeles, supervised by Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906-1998) was a linguist and Indologist who earned his Ph.D. at the University of London under Ralph Lilley Turner. He taught at Sir Parashurambhau College, founded Deccan College, and was professor emeritus at UT Austin (~1971-1976).

Sun-Ah Choi works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Chicago under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi, and studied with Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.

Sunanda Mukhopadhyay works in linguistics and Indology. Supervised for doctoral studies by Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya, Mukhopadhyay held a position as a Research Scholar / Fellow at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sunayana Maiti is an Indology and history/archaeology scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Calcutta (2014-2021). She served at The Asiatic Society as a Research Fellow in History of Science (2017-2021) and as a Research Scholar/Fellow (attested 2026).

Sung Yong Kang is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He studied at Seoul National University (~1986-1993) and the University of Hamburg (~1997-2004), and has held academic appointments at Seoul National University (~2007) and the University of Vienna.

Sung-Bae Park (born 1933) is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar. Supervised by Lewis Lancaster for his doctorate (~1974-1979), he taught at Dongguk University (~1968-1972) and became Professor Emeritus at Stony Brook University (post from 1977).
Sung-Eun Kim is a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies. She completed her PhD at Seoul National University (2004-2012) and was appointed Assistant Professor at Dongguk University in 2020.

Sungdoo Ahn is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who earned a PhD at the University of Hamburg (-2001) under Lambert Schmithausen. He served as Director at Geumgang University and as Professor at Seoul National University (attested 2013).

Sungtaek Cho (born 1957) is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy. Educated at Konkuk University and Korea University, he held posts at Stony Brook University, Korea University (2003; 2012-2017; 2019-2020), and Gyeonggi Research Institute (2020).
